title: Taskalisk doctor issue
description: Every finding doctor --bundle found for one subject: an issue, a pull request (a trust warning), or, with subject null, the plan as a whole (a plan warning). One line per subject, issues in the order of their references, the plan last; findings sorted by code, then the reference they concern. A finding's code is an entry of issue-dag-core's catalogue CODES (docs/topics/findings/README.md) and its severity is the catalogue's. A message is fixed text for its code; no line carries a title or a line of a body.

run.description: The execution this line belongs to (Parley spec 2.1).

subject.description: The issue or pull request, owner/repo#N; null for the plan as a whole.

errors.description: The findings below whose severity is error.

warnings.description: The findings below whose severity is warning.

code.description: The catalogue CODES, in its order (a test holds the two equal).

severity.description: The catalogue's severity for the code.

family.description: Which check found it: document (a frontmatter document, rules C, L, V, P3 and X1), profile (a planning profile rule of the run), cause (why a reference resolves to nothing, D11 to D13), body (a body warning), shape (a shape warning), plan (a plan warning) or trust (a trust warning).

concerns.description: The reference the finding concerns, for D3, D5, X2, X3 and a redundant edge's prerequisite.

detail.description: What the check measured: implied_via (a redundant edge); reduced_edges, open_nodes, density and band (edge density); login and rule (a trust warning; login null for a deleted account); rule, not_found and unavailable, the reason the bundle records (a cause).

version.description: Full validation is against the schema for this exact id and version (Parley spec 4.5).
